blocking_findings.detail: Release-scoped pair projection IDs feed component IDs, which feed family origin keys. A release-only change therefore forces every family origin to change.
Historical import reads the supplied V36 review CSV directly despite the brief restricting it to regression use.
R35 rows cite the review audit as the exact prior artifact; R31 rows are blanket UNKNOWN without a cumulative source-recoverability audit.
The loader inserts a partial hash; --finalize-hashes later updates every candidate revision.
p3a_v37_reports.py parses section-57 v35_populated_q01_q54_raw.tsv rather than executing q01-q54 against R37.
53,611 ledger rows are delivered, but no delivered production code inserts or derives them.
Unresolved exact authority is labelled exact-only; other-domain redirect is labelled precedence-overlap conflict.
Negative cases accept any exception; incomplete-promotion mapping still fails at missing variant assignment.
p3a_v37_reports.py hardcodes the local workspace/DSN and writes stale F57/D57 findings while claiming v37.
